name: The New Kid on the Block
detailed_description:
Explore and share Jack Prelutsky’s classic "The New Kid on the Block", adapted from the original 1984 storybook into an interactive animated adventure! A collection of 17 poems come alive one word at a time, offering an easy to digest reading mode which is fully animated and voiced. Increase the challenge and the fun with an interactive at-your-own-pace option with lots of bonuses and secrets to discover!

Each poem hosted and recited by Jack Prelutsky himself. Every story brings a fun and exciting adventure to life featuring a cast of off the wall characters and situations. You can choose from all 17 poems from the very start and follow along with the rhythm. "The New Kid on the Block" also features exclusive bonus songs.

A revitalized classic, Living Books' rendition of "The New Kid on the Block" has been enjoyed by countless children since its first release in 1993. Step-by-step, the player will discover charming characters, new and fun scenes at every corner, and outrageous laughs! Everything comes together for a one-of-a-kind multimedia experience to interact with time and time again!

  • Both interactive and story modes suitable for different levels of skill.

  • Interact with the pictures and discover hidden scenes.

  • Attractive animations bring the characters to life.

  • Fully voiced as you read! Many memorable scenes!

  • A revitalized re-release compatible with modern platforms.

  • A great way to improve reading skills.
